title: clove plugin install/uninstall/update envelope
description: The success envelope of the three mutating `clove plugin` commands. Each has its own `data` shape, distinguished by which of `installed` / `uninstalled` / `updated` is present. `ok: true` does NOT mean something changed: a declined confirmation, an already-installed package, and an up-to-date check all succeed with a payload saying nothing happened — callers must read the payload, not the exit code, to learn whether the machine changed. A failure uses `error.json` instead.

installed.title: install succeeded
installed.description: A plugin was built and placed in clove's install root. `version` is set on the crates.io path; `source`/`commit` on the `--git` path, where `commit` is the exact revision that was inspected and then built (a tag or branch is resolved to a SHA before cargo is invoked, so the approved tree is the built tree).

binary.description: The single executable that was installed. It always equals the crate name — a crate may not install a binary belonging to another plugin's namespace.

path.description: Absolute path of the installed executable, inside clove's install root — never `~/.cargo/bin`.

source.description: The git URL, on the `--git` path only.

commit.description: The resolved commit SHA that was built, on the `--git` path only.

notInstalled.title: install made no change
notInstalled.description: The command succeeded without installing anything: the user answered no (`declined`), or the plugin was already present and `--force` was not given (`already_installed`).

uninstalled.title: uninstall succeeded
uninstalled.description: A plugin clove had installed was removed. Only plugins recorded in clove's own install root are eligible, so this can never remove something clove did not put there.

updated.title: update result
updated.description: What `clove plugin update` did. `updated` is empty when everything was current, when the user declined, or when every candidate was blocked by a gate (a yanked release, a crate that no longer depends on `clove-plugin`); the blocked reasons are reported on stderr, not here. `checked` counts the plugins considered — it is 0 only when no clove-installed plugin exists.

scope.description: `all` when every clove-installed plugin was considered (no name, or `--all`), `one` when a single plugin was named. This is what disambiguates `checked: 0`.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems — e.g. installing from an unpinned git ref, or a per-package failure during a multi-package update that did not stop the run.
